dispatch_table_bytes_source: pinned ELF PT_LOAD and R_AARCH64_RELATIVE relocations
interpretation: The five out-of-image relocation addends are encoded pointers. Native arithmetic corrects them to file-backed .data.rel.ro tables; each loaded relocated word is decoded by subtracting the live frame bias before BR. No separate runtime writer or external mapping is needed for these five tables in this continuation. This supersedes the earlier missing-external-owner hypothesis.
limitations: Synthetic request/JNI/OS/import providers remain those of the parent probe.
The continuation visits tables 0 and 1; all-five selector controls stop before handler bodies.
The native return remains a continuation, not whole-request differential or signing.
